ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Rundll32 Activity Invoking Sys File
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious process related to rundll32 based on command line that includes a *.sys file as seen being used by UNC2452

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*rundll32\\\.exe.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.sys\\,.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.sys\\ .*")))
